known_limitations: The loop is advisory only and deliberately pauses on missing or conflicting evidence.
It consumes current local artifacts and does not regenerate upstream scheduler, validation, notification, or briefing evidence.
summary: Implemented an evidence-only Autonomous Operations Control Loop that reads local scheduler, worker, steward presence, validation, notification, briefing, and operations board artifacts to recommend continue, pause, or recall-recommended without executing work or notifying the Steward.
